entry_requirements_summary: "Students with a BA degree in Media Studies from the University of Groningen are DIRECTLY ADMITTED. Students with ANY OTHER BA degree need to have AT LEAST 30 ECTS CREDIT POINTS from course units from the Minor in Media Studies provided by the University of Groningen, or course units EQUIVALENT TO THESE IN CONTENT followed at a different university." BRIDGING ROUTES, from RUG's own transfer table: from ALL RESEARCH UNIVERSITIES - entry "via a pre-master with a MAXIMUM OF 30 EC"; from a Media Studies BA at any research university - "no additional requirements"; from ALL UNIVERSITIES OF APPLIED SCIENCES (HBO) - direct application is NOT possible and a pre-master of UP TO 60 EC is required. Programme: 90 EC over 18 months, including Innovation and Entrepreneurial Culture (5), Methods: Texts and Practices (10), Transformations in the Digital Society (10), Media and Global Challenges (5), Theories of Cultural Production and Practice (5), Media Lab (10), Research Seminar (10), Thesis Lab (5), MA Thesis (15, or Thesis Plus 25) and an MA Internship (15). No February start.

fit_notes: || W3-3: THE BRIDGING ROUTE IS NOW QUANTIFIED, WHICH IS THE ONE GENUINELY USEFUL THING THIS ROW OFFERS. RUG's own transfer table states that applicants from ALL RESEARCH UNIVERSITIES enter 'via a pre-master with a MAXIMUM OF 30 EC' (HBO holders need up to 60 EC). A 300-ECTS Tunisian engineering diploma should be assessed as research-university level, so the realistic plan is a pre-master of up to 30 EC (roughly one semester) followed by the 18-month MA - about two years in total. COST OF THAT PLAN: 18 months of master tuition at EUR 19,900/yr is about EUR 29,850, PLUS whatever the pre-master costs, in Groningen, for a media-studies degree with no technical content. FOR A FUNDING-FIRST CLIENT THIS DOES NOT ADD UP. Contrast the sibling RUG row J-105 (Popular Music and Sonic Cultures, 60 EC, 12 months, EUR 19,900 once, same 1 May 2027 deadline, same Admissions-Board pre-master mechanism) - if a Groningen media/culture degree is wanted at all, that is the cheaper and shorter door. The one date to keep either way: 1 MAY 2027.
